guidance.summary: 15% to 20% growth expected on a 6-month level for this year
guidance.speaker: Vishal Gupta
guidance.quote: Overall, 6 months for this quarter, I will say we will see a growth, but we will not see a very large growth. It should be around 15%, 20% growth, should be there on a 6-month level for this year.

guidance.summary: Aspiring for about 8% operating margin for the full year
guidance.speaker: Pramod Gupta
guidance.quote: And initially, at the beginning of this year, we had guided that we should be probably close to 8% kind of a margin for the whole year, at least at the operating level, which is this quarter about 7.3%. And we are hopefully going to reach that number on a full year basis.

guidance.summary: Total capex for this year is about INR 400 crores
guidance.speaker: Pramod Gupta
guidance.quote: This year, the total capex that we have is about INR400 crores, which is going to actually be utilized in completing the ongoing projects of compressor and refrigerator.
